goal: Multi-Tenant Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & API Token Authentication
context: Enforce strict cryptographic workspace tenant isolation and staff permissions (admin, manager, sales_rep) to prevent cross-workspace data leakage and unauthorized catalog or billing mutations.
requirements: Build token-based session authenticator (Bearer token & secure HTTP headers)
Implement RBAC decorator or enforcement checks for dashboard endpoints
Isolate product CRUD, billing settings, and lead exports to authorized roles
Enforce 403 Forbidden on tenant cross-access attempts
acceptance_criteria: Rejects unauthorized tenant access with 403 Forbidden and permits authorized staff operations with valid token
